verses.text: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek wal jun tik ex yinhtilal Jacob, ex tze kuch Israel, yinhtilal ex pax Judá. Tze lok in b'i a in Jehová in tik, tzeyalani to tzex och ejmelal t'ayin he Diosal in, palta manh yelok tzeyala', chab'satil tzex loloni.
Tzeyalani to aj chonhab' ex t'a in chonhab' wiknhej yaji. Tzin eyak'anoch yipok he k'ool eyalani, a in ton Jehová he Diosal in Yajal in t'a Smasanil.
Ayokto walannakkan yuj tas ix uji tik. Ha in wal ix wak' eyojtakejeli. Elanhchamel ix laj elk'och tas walnakkan chi'.
Wojtak to te pit ex, max eyik'em he b'a, max ex k'ixwi jab'ok t'a wichanh.

Ayokto walannakkan t'ayex ayik manto uji juntzanh tik. Yuj chi' max yal eyalan icha tik yuj juntzanh he komon Dios nab'a te', ma k'een: Ha ko diosal tik ix naan jun tik, a ix ak'an elk'ochi, manh xe chiok.
Ha ex tik eyab'nak masanil tas walnakkan chi'. Scham wal he naan yuj, tzeyalaneli to yel walnak. Haxo tiknaik ol wak' eyojtakejel juntzanhxo tas k'ub'eltak yaji, juntzanh manh eyojtakok.
Haton tas to hato tiknaik swala', manh walnakok t'a peka', juntzanh tas to malaj b'aj eyab'nak spekal yalji masanto tiknaik. Yuj chi' manh ol yal eyalani to eyojtakxo.
Yel toni, a jun tik manta b'aj eyab'nak, manto eyojtakok, hanheja' manto eyab'pax tiknaik. Yujto wojtaktaxoni to max he k'anab'ajej, pit ex yiktax ex alji.
Palta ay in niwank'olal t'ayex, yuj chi' ix in yamoch waan yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh yuj in b'inajnakil. Maj ex in sateli yik manh chukok tz'aj in b'inaji.
Naek to ix ex in sakb'itej, manh ichok tz'aj k'een plata t'a kal k'ak', palta haton yet' yaelal ix ex wak' prowal.
Yuj wik'jichaanh, icha chi' ex wutej, yik manh chukok tz'aj yalchaj in b'i. Ha aloj wach' lolonel smoj yalji t'ayin, max in cha alchaj t'a junokxo, xchi Jehová.
Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ha ex sik'b'il ex el wuuj. Ha innhej ton Dios in, b'ab'el waj t'a smasanil, slajwub' in paxi.
Ha in wak'nakkanem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, in jenhb'annakb'at satcha'anh yet' in poder. Tonhej walnak sb'i juntzanh tik, spitzwinakchaanh.

Molb'ejek he b'a he masanil, tzeyab'an tas ol wala': ¿Mach wal junok komon Dios ayokto yalannak to a jun winh winak sik'b'ilel wuuj, a winh ol k'ulan masanil tas nab'ilxo wuj t'a yib'anh Babilonia to a yipalil ol satanel heb' caldeo?
Ha in ol wawtejkot winh, ol jawok winh, yalnhej b'aj ol b'at winh, ol yak'nhej ganar winh.

Nitzekkot he b'a t'ayin, ab'ek tas ol wala': Yiktax ix in yamanoch in lolon t'a heb' anima, k'unnhej snachajel tas swala', haxo tz'elk'och tas swal chi', ayinnhej ek' ta', xchi Jehová. Ha tiknaik jun, chekb'il in kot yuj Jehová Yajal, yik tzin lolon yuj spoder Yespíritu.
Ha Jehová Dios, ko Kolumal a onh israel onh tik Haxonhej Ochi, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, a in tzin ch'ox t'ayex tas ol och he wach'ilok, a in tzin ch'ox b'e b'aj smoj tzex b'ati.
Komonok wal ix he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, tato icha chi' a wach'ilal tze cha'a tzam k'enhej chaanh icha ha' niwak ha' max tupi, haxo he kolnab'il tzam janhej icha skotnhej b'alaljok sat ha' mar.
Manhxom b'ischajb'enok heb' eyinhtilal, icha yarenail sti' ha' mar. Maj am wik'emta he b'isul, maj am in b'at mikan t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Elanhek t'a Babilonia, elanhek elelal t'a skal heb' aj Caldea. Alekel jun ab'ix tik yet' aw yik tzalajk'olal. Tzeyak'an ojtakajel masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Tzeyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová onh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' Babilonia, a onh yinhtil onh Jacob, haton jun schekab', xe chi, xchi Jehová.
Ayik yek'nak heb' ko mam kicham t'a takinh lu'um yuj Jehová, manh takjinakok sti' heb', yujto a Jehová chi' pojjinak k'een tenam, yelnakkot chulnaj ha' niwak ha' sb'eyi.
Haxo pax heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj jab'ok wach'il ol scha heb', xchi Jehová.
